scope: runtime.py, engine.py, _native/models.py, _native/worker.py; connected frozen entry points, SceneClient and Common model loop

findings_fixed.finding: Public execution entry points accepted modified model instructions, public handles or budgets after input preparation.
findings_fixed.fix: Use the shared catalog validator in runtime_plan and native run_episode before provider/scene contact; bind runtime selection and materialization receipt to the profile, public task and native instruction.

findings_fixed.finding: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN inherited from an unrelated parent configuration were retained in the simulator child environment.
findings_fixed.fix: Remove both supported Anthropic credential variables and its conventional endpoint override alongside the existing provider defaults and selected custom credential.

findings_fixed.finding: A valid model identifier with surrounding whitespace was normalized by the frozen provider but not by run records or the L2 watchdog, preventing safe-point interruption and causing strict result identity rejection.
findings_fixed.fix: Record the provider-normalized model identifier and compare the watchdog manifest against the same normalization.

preserved_existing_fixes: Worker KeyboardInterrupt responses retain a typed failure instead of an invalid empty protocol response.
Empty native failure messages fall back to the error type.
limitations: Parser checks mock external interpreter, dependency and GPU verification and never call package preparation.
No real provider request, simulator, GPU, SSH, resident service or queue was started.

The native SceneClient status protocol does not attest task seed; the CLI checks seed through immutable input admission, while a direct model API caller remains responsible for supplying that frozen binding.
The historical safe-point observation/signal race remains; no watchdog phase or frozen termination semantics were changed.
evidence_stage: Runtime and task binding review; the subsequent credential-preview repair has separate final regression evidence.
